description: Ding, Yu and colleagues describe this resource in the native deposit. The collection covers twelve turbines arranged as six isolated pairs and three meteorological masts during 2010–2011. The stated geometry excludes other nearby turbine influences within the specified ten-diameter context. Power and environmental variables support comparison of upstream and downstream wake effects. The object is a derived wake-analysis collection; other DSWE datasets may share the same farm measurements. Common provenance is preserved without asserting independent farm populations or reconstructing anonymized locations. Zenodo provides the deposit with open access under cc-by-4.0. The native file inventory establishes deposited data, but values and linked file bodies were not read. Coverage is limited to the stated experiment, model or application; transfer to other turbines, sites or operating regimes requires separate assessment. Publication date alone does not establish current maintenance.
